suggested_experiment_name: LOFAR (Low Frequency Array) solar corona dark photon search
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter χ (dimensionless), as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper reports 95% C.L. upper limit on kinetic mixing parameter ε ≈ 10^-13 for dark photon dark matter in the frequency range 30–80 MHz. This corresponds to dark photon masses m_A' ≈ 1–6 × 10^-7 eV (derived from plasma frequency ω_p = m_A' at resonance). The limit is ~1 order of magnitude better than CMB constraints. Data extracted from Fig. 4 and main text statement. DM density ρ_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm³ assumed throughout. The y-axis shows kinetic mixing ε on a logarithmic scale from 10^-12 to 10^-6. The cyan shaded region indicates the LOFAR constraint. The boundary traced represents the lower edge of the excluded region (upper limit on ε).
